notes: This is a dose-response paper (ifdoseresponse=1) with 4 chitosan doses: 0.125%, 0.25%, 0.5%, 1.0% (= 125, 250, 500, 1000 ppm). The GT outcome is total fruit yield per plant (strawberry). The AI extractor captured total fruit weight per plant only for 125 ppm and 250 ppm dose arms, missing 500 ppm and 1000 ppm. The AI instead focused heavily on vegetative and biomass outcomes (leaf dimensions, canopy, shoot/root weights). For the 125 ppm arm, the GT effect (+28.1%) closely matches json_idx 35 (+28.9%), confirming the yield metric identity. For the 250 ppm arm, json_idx 33 shows a lower effect (+21.7% vs GT +32.0%), suggesting the AI may have captured a different sub-table or the paper reports partially averaged data. The 500 ppm and 1000 ppm arms are unmatched — a coverage failure.
